Title: Run signed runbooks in Azure Automation

Body.Content:
In the Azure Automation service, you can now configure Hybrid Runbook Workers to run only signed runbooks. After you configure the worker, all unsigned runbooks will fail to run.

To learn more about this new capability, visit the documentation page.
